key_fields.name: ACCOUNT-RECORD
key_fields.meaning: 300-byte account master record (comment RECLN 300; field sizes add up to 300).

key_fields.name: ACCT-ID
key_fields.meaning: 11-digit account number, key of the account file (FD-ACCT-ID in programs).

key_fields.name: ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS
key_fields.meaning: 1-byte account active status flag; no 88-level values are defined here.

key_fields.name: ACCT-CURR-BAL
key_fields.meaning: Signed current balance S9(10)V99; CBACT04C adds monthly interest to it.

key_fields.name: ACCT-REISSUE-DATE
key_fields.meaning: 10-byte reissue date; CBACT01C treats it as YYYY-MM-DD when converting with COBDATFT.

key_fields.name: ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
key_fields.meaning: Current-cycle credit total; reset to 0 by CBACT04C at interest posting.

key_fields.name: ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
key_fields.meaning: Current-cycle debit total; reset to 0 by CBACT04C at interest posting.

key_fields.name: ACCT-GROUP-ID
key_fields.meaning: Account (disclosure) group id used by CBACT04C as the first part of the DISCGRP key to find the interest rate.

observations.text: The expiration date field is misspelled ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE; the misspelling propagates to programs and to CVEXPORT (EXP-ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE).
Dates (open, expiration, reissue) are stored as 10-byte character fields with no format definition; their YYYY-MM-DD format is only implied by callers.

purpose: CVACT01Y defines ACCOUNT-RECORD, the 300-byte account master entity of CardDemo: account id, active status, current balance, credit and cash limits, open/expiration/reissue dates, current-cycle credit and debit totals, ZIP and account group id. It is one of the most widely used layouts: batch programs CBACT01C, CBACT04C, CBEXPORT, CBIMPORT, CBSTM03A, CBTRN01C, CBTRN02C and many online programs (COACTUPC, COACTVWC, COBIL00C, COCRDSLC, COCRDUPC, COTRN02C, authorization and VSAM-MQ programs) copy it.
